# Version 4.157.0
> **GPU rendering and filter correctness** · Released November 17, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.157.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.157.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.157.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.157.0 brings Skia m157 with more reliable GPU geometry, text and image filtering. The stable cut adds mask-filtered glyph handling and antialiased image-subset fixes. Managed APIs remain unchanged; generated LibraryImport declarations now explicitly select the native cdecl calling convention.

## Breaking Changes

- **Check Graphite Metal deployment targets** — The m157 Graphite Metal backend adopts an iOS and tvOS 15 runtime minimum; macOS remains at 12. Raise any lower application deployment targets before using this backend, and continue to honor higher managed or framework requirements. ([#5542](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5542))

## Engine

- **Skia m157 with existing managed bindings** — Moves the engine to milestone 157 without changing managed declarations. HarfBuzzSharp package revision 14.4.0.200 retains native HarfBuzz 14.4.0 rather than introducing a new HarfBuzz engine version. ([#5542](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5542))

## Bug Fixes

- **Clipped paths and filtered image subsets** — Corrects convex antialiased path rasterization across clip gaps, coverage-mask clamping and transformed ellipse/rounded-rectangle geometry. AA and MSAA image draws keep sampling within their logical subsets under minification or strong skew, and image-filter cache equality now matches its bytewise hash. ([#5612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5612), [#5630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5630), [#5688](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5688), [#5770](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5770))
- **Glyph replay and mask-filtered text** — Validates direct-mask glyph replay, rounds interpolated atlas indices and clears stale atlas work after empty flushes. Mask-filtered glyphs use their reloaded paths and formats, reject incompatible mask copies and preserve full plane strides when clipping embossed glyphs. ([#5612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5612), [#5630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5630), [#5670](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5670), [#5688](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5688), [#5748](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5748))
- **Graphite clipping and GPU filter precision** — Corrects clip keys, wedge bounds and alpha-to-RGBx readback stride, and counts pending clips against render-pass capacity. Reflected zero-length hairline caps stay device-sized, and displacement offsets use fp32 arithmetic to match filter bounds. ([#5612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5612), [#5630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5630), [#5670](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5670), [#5688](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5688), [#5710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5710))
- **Vulkan synchronization and device-loss cleanup** — Native synchronous submission incorporates fence-wait failures; GRContext.Submit remains void and adds no managed result. A targeted 1 ms device-loss cleanup delay applies to affected ARM proprietary driver versions from 42 up to, but not including, 56, not ordinary successful submissions. ([#5670](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5670), [#5710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5710))
- **Explicit cdecl imports** — Generated LibraryImport declarations now specify CallConvCdecl, matching the existing DllImport and callback paths. This corrects the ABI mismatch implicated in Windows x86 stack growth without changing public APIs or native exports. The reported stack-growth symptom still needs Windows x86 runtime validation. ([#5565](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5565))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.200

HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.200 continues to bundle HarfBuzz 14.4.0 with no public-package API changes. Its generated LibraryImport declarations now explicitly use cdecl, matching the existing native calling convention.

## Release Candidate 2 (November 13, 2026)

Release Candidate 2 corrected transformed GPU geometry, stale atlas work and Graphite clip-capacity handling. Displacement offsets gained fp32 precision, and native synchronous Vulkan submission now incorporates fence-wait failures without adding a managed return value.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6...v4.157.0-rc.2.26563.19)

## Release Candidate 1 (November 9, 2026)

Release Candidate 1 corrected reflected hairline square caps and GPU text-atlas selection. It also added a targeted device-loss cleanup delay for affected ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1...v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6)

## Preview 1 (November 6, 2026)

Preview 1 introduced Skia m157 with clipped-path rasterization, glyph replay and Graphite readback fixes. Generated LibraryImport declarations explicitly select cdecl; HarfBuzzSharp's new package revision still bundles HarfBuzz 14.4.0.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.156.1...v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1)
